title: Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme

compensation.value: CHF 12'000 per semester, from HS27 onwards 13'500 CHF, plus a tuition fee waiver
compensation.evidence_quote: CHF 12'000 per semester, from HS27 onwards 13'500 CHF, plus a tuition fee waiver

about: ETH Zurich's Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme (ESOP) supports Master's students starting in autumn 2027. Applicants apply in the first application window, 1-30 November 2026, and upload a Master's thesis pre-proposal. About 60 scholarships are planned.

upskill.name: AI for Education Academy
why: "upload a Master's thesis pre-proposal" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis." (A010.07, in this Academy; course score below course_min_score, so the Academy page is linked)
